projects.title: Open Source Software (Notepad++)
projects.description: Enhanced several features that are integrated with Notepad++.  I extended the auto word completion feature for personal use and made modifications to the graphical user interface.

projects.title: Stock Market Visualizer
projects.description: A personal project made to display the current stock prices. Only those stocks the application user is interested on will be displayed. The user can customize the colors of each stock price and select the time frame for historical data prices.
